title: Looks very retro
text: Looks very retro. Most of the items in my kitchen are white including my old dish rack. This 1 is a black metal. My old 1 was metal Underneath with a white Rubberized coating. Old 1 was cracked where the coding came off The metal began to rust and 1 of the holders for the silverware cup was broken so So it was time for a new 1. I decided on this 1 because it had 2 Racks And I thought that might be different and better. Everything is detachable you get 1Cup holder that holds about 5 cups I think And can be put on either of the racks. Then it has the silverware holder which is square And has 3 compartments And it's made out of a metal mesh. When I do my silverware I always put the eating side up But with this rack It has bars that go straight across on the front and sides and my silverware kept slipping through So I have to put on the opposite way which was just something different to learn. This rack is also little smaller Which was okay, So I had to configure where to put Items like my coffee cups how the plates would stand in the larger 1And have the bowls we're gonna go. Eventually I figured it out and it's a niceEventually I figured it out and it's a nice dish rack. Its a good quality and I hope it lasts a long time.

product_metadata.title: 2 Pack Dish Drying Rack, Dish Rack Suitable for Little Countertop Space,Installation-Free Metal Dish Drainer with Drainboard Not Limited to The Sink - Dishes Racks Organizer Set (Black)
features: 【Amazing space saver】The 2Pack kitchen dish drying rack is an essential item for saving countertop space. It includes two dish racks, one is larger than the other, you can use one or both depending on your needs.
【Unrestricted position】The tray in the bottom has a lip on all sides, so they can be put anywhere, not just next to the sink.

【Easy to clean and dry】The drip tray can easily slide in and out of the dish rack, easy to clean at any time, to avoid the water can not be completely discharged, leaving stagnant water on the drain rack, breeding stains.

【No installation required】 The dish drying rack is ready to use as soon as you take it out of the box. In addition to the dish racks, you'll also receive a cutlery holder and a cup holder, making it even more efficient to organize and store your kitchen items.
【Sleek and modern】Simple appearance, stable structure, big enough to hold most items that don't go in the dishwasher, Is the best choice to save space. (USPTO Patent Pending, Number:29873152)
